title: Pixel 11 puts Gemini in the operating system, weeks before Siri gets the same models
excerpt: Google has launched the Pixel 11 line with agentic Gemini features, weeks before Apple ships a rebuilt Siri running on Google's own models.
content_html:
Google has launched the Pixel 11, 11 Pro, 11 Pro XL and 11 Pro Fold with Gemini Intelligence acting across apps rather than sitting in a chatbot. It arrives weeks before Apple ships a Siri rebuilt on Google’s own models, and devices chief Rick Osterloh confirmed the memory shortage will push Pixel prices up.

Google has launched the Pixel 11 line with Gemini at the centre of it, weeks before Apple ships a rebuilt Siri running on Google’s own models. The range covers the Pixel 11, 11 Pro, 11 Pro XL and 11 Pro Fold. The pitch is software rather than hardware.

Gemini Intelligence is meant to read what a user is doing and connect messages, calendar, maps and other Google services, then suggest or carry out the next step, checking availability or starting a restaurant booking. Google is pushing those features into the operating system rather than a separate chatbot app.

Which puts the company in an odd position. It is now selling directly against one of its largest AI customers, since Apple is rebuilding Siri on Gemini and chasing much the same goals, understanding personal context, reading what is on screen and acting across apps.

Rick Osterloh, Google’s devices chief, told CNBC the two will not end up in the same place. “I think obviously Pixel and iPhone are going in very different directions,” he said, pointing to scam detection, Rambler voice transcription and Gemini’s depth in Android as things “unique to Android and Gemini Intelligence.”

He went further on where all this leads. “For the last 10 to 15 years, not a lot has changed in how you use laptops and mobile phones,” Osterloh said, describing Gemini Intelligence as “a totally new way to interact with a computer” that could “perhaps someday become the primary way that people use their phones, their laptops and other devices.”

Whether it sells phones is another matter. Counterpoint Research puts AI around sixth or seventh among reasons people upgrade, up one or two places as Gemini and Apple Intelligence have improved. Research director Tarun Pathak said awareness and concrete use cases will decide whether that interest converts.

Pathak also expects Apple Intelligence to drive upgrades, because Apple already has more generative AI-capable phones in people’s hands than any other brand. Google gets to show the model first. Apple gets to deploy it at scale.

The launch also lands with costs moving the wrong way. Osterloh said there is “quite clearly a shortage of memory, both RAM memory and flash memory,” and that “everyone’s needing to raise their prices,” Google included. It confirms what the company flagged in July, when RAM had gone from $2.80 a gigabyte to $12.

The squeeze reaches well past phones. AI data centres are absorbing the supply, which has already killed the cheap smartphone and finished off the $599 Mac Mini.

content_html_zh:
谷歌推出了 Pixel 11、11 Pro、11 Pro XL 和 11 Pro Fold，Gemini Intelligence 可以跨应用程序运行，而不是坐在聊天机器人中。 几周后，苹果公司就推出了基于谷歌自己的型号重建的 Siri，设备负责人 Rick Osterloh 证实，内存短缺将推高 Pixel 价格。

谷歌推出了以 Gemini 为核心的 Pixel 11 系列，几周前苹果就发布了在谷歌自己的机型上运行的重建版 Siri。 该系列涵盖 Pixel 11、11 Pro、11 Pro XL 和 11 Pro Fold。 重点是软件而不是硬件。

Gemini Intelligence 旨在读取用户正在做什么，并连接消息、日历、地图和其他 Google 服务，然后建议或执行下一步，检查可用性或开始餐厅预订。 谷歌正在将这些功能推送到操作系统中，而不是单独的聊天机器人应用程序。

这使该公司处于一个奇怪的境地。 它现在直接针对其最大的人工智能客户之一进行销售，因为苹果正在 Gemini 上重建 Siri，并追求大致相同的目标，了解个人背景、阅读屏幕上的内容以及跨应用程序执行操作。

谷歌设备主管里克·奥斯特洛 (Rick Osterloh) 告诉 CNBC，两者最终不会出现在同一个地方。 他说：“我认为 Pixel 和 iPhone 显然正在走向截然不同的方向。”他指出，诈骗检测、Rambler 语音转录和 Gemini 在 Android 领域的深度都是“Android 和 Gemini Intelligence 所独有的”。

他进一步探讨了这一切的走向。 Osterloh 表示：“在过去 10 到 15 年里，您使用笔记本电脑和手机的方式并没有发生太大变化。”他将 Gemini Intelligence 描述为“一种与计算机交互的全新方式”，“也许有一天会成为人们使用手机、笔记本电脑和其他设备的主要方式”。

是否销售手机则是另一回事。 Counterpoint Research 将人工智能列为人们升级的原因中的第六或第七位，随着 Gemini 和 Apple Intelligence 的改进，排名上升了一到两位。 研究总监塔伦·帕塔克 (Tarun Pathak) 表示，意识和具体用例将决定这种兴趣是否会转化。

Pathak 还预计 Apple Intelligence 将推动升级，因为苹果已经比任何其他品牌拥有更多具有生成式 AI 功能的手机。 谷歌首先展示了模型。 苹果开始大规模部署它。

此次发布的成本也出现了错误。 奥斯特洛表示，“内存（RAM 内存和闪存）都明显短缺”，“每个人都需要提高价格”，谷歌补充道。 它证实了该公司 7 月份的说法，当时 RAM 的价格从每 GB 2.80 美元涨到了 12 美元。

这种压力远远超出了手机的范围。 人工智能数据中心正在吸收供应，这已经杀死了廉价智能手机并消灭了 599 美元的 Mac Mini。
